passages.note: Her quoted words describe closing camps with 30 days notice and outreach but name no penalty on the person; the parks no-camping policy is stated in the city's voice and names no instrument or penalty.
Says closures are used only as a last step alongside outreach; no penalty rule and no shelter-availability condition stated.
Urges the County to close an encampment sooner; supports clearing encampments but names no penalty type.
Housing supply, reunification and service staffing; says nothing about penalties for public sleeping or camping.
General statement on a housing and homelessness report; no penalty rule for public camping.

rows.reasoning: Her own words support closing encampments after notice and outreach ("We use encampment closures only as a last step, and always alongside outreach."), which fits the prohibition and warning clauses of "Prohibiting encampments on public property, enforced through graduated warnings and civil penalties" but never states the civil-penalty clause; per the annex, clearances with notice and no penalty on the person are compound-partial for that rung. Nothing she says conditions enforcement on available shelter beds or names criminal penalties.

quotes.text: When it’s necessary to close a camp, we’re following the Housing Network’s recommended camp-moving guidelines whenever possible.
We use encampment closures only as a last step, and always alongside outreach.
I urge our County partners to move that timeline forward.
